items.title: Demand Centers Drive Natural Gas Spot Prices Higher Ahead of EIA Storage Report
items.summary: Physical natural gas prices diverged Wednesday for Thursday flow as New England and California posted the session’s strongest gains while benchmark Henry Hub weakened ahead of Thursday’s US Energy Information Administration (EIA) storage report.

items.title: Natural Gas Becoming ‘Strategic Energy Resource,’ EOG Says
items.summary: EOG Resources emphasized long-term US natural gas demand during its second quarter earnings call Wednesday, citing expanding LNG exports and electricity demand as the market increasingly evolves.

items.title: Storage Keeps Natural Gas Bulls in Check Despite Improving Fundamentals
items.summary: Natural gas futures finished mixed Wednesday as modest improvements in daily supply-demand balances supported the front of the curve while traders remained focused on Thursday’s US Energy Information Administration (EIA) storage report.

items.title: US LNG Exports Tread Water in July as Europe Reclaims Market Share
items.summary: US LNG exports held roughly flat in July at about 10.26 Mt, slightly up from June but 2.4% below the 10.51 Mt monthly average during the first half of the year, according to Kpler data.

items.title: NextDecade Sees Hormuz Disruption Tightening LNG Supply Through 2030
items.summary: The prolonged closure of the Strait of Hormuz shifted the outlook of the global LNG market, keeping spot prices elevated through the end of the decade, NextDecade CEO Matt Schatzman told analysts.

items.title: BP Divesting From RNG, Sees Haynesville Natural Gas as ‘Significant Position’
items.summary: BP executives said they would be marketing their US renewable natural gas (RNG) business, Archaea Energy, just four years after making a splash by purchasing the firm for $4.1 billion as part of a net-zero carbon push.

items.title: Prices Cool as Natural Gas Producers Match Mother Nature’s Might
items.summary: Supply again appeared ample to meet demand — as it has most of the summer — stalling September New York Mercantile Exchange (NYMEX) natural gas futures at midday on Wednesday.

items.title: Coastal Bend LNG Takes Crucial Early Step, Enters Federal Regulatory Process
items.summary: The Coastal Bend LNG project in Texas has entered the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC) process, announcing this week that it has started the pre-filing review phase and expects to file a formal application with the Commission next year.
